checkpoint.name: Atrapar a Doyle
checkpoint.objective: Arrest the harbor master before he flees.

state.canon: Asuntos Internos arrestó al teniente Brandt después de ver las fotos del muelle. Maeve declaró que quien pagaba a la policía del puerto era el jefe del puerto, Doyle. El libro de cuentas del contrabandista apareció bajo el suelo de la lavandería de Pike Street.

entries.title: Teniente Brandt
entries.content: El teniente Brandt dirige la policía del puerto y cobra sobornos cada semana en el muelle nueve.

entries.title: El libro de cuentas
entries.content: Nadie sabe dónde está el libro de cuentas del contrabandista.

entries.title: Blue Anchor
entries.content: El Blue Anchor es un club nocturno junto al muelle nueve; Maeve canta allí casi todas las noches.

entries.title: Doyle
entries.content: Doyle, el jefe del puerto, tiene una lancha amarrada en el muelle doce, lista para huir.

entries.title: Mae Hollis
entries.content: Mae Hollis es detective de homicidios y la compañera de Max desde hace seis años.

entries.title: Lluvia en Mercer Street
entries.content: En Mercer Street llueve casi todas las noches y las farolas parpadean.

checkpoint.name: Find the Artifact
checkpoint.objective: Recover the Sun's Heart Artifact from the inner chamber.

state.canon: Max accepted the Sun Ruins contract from Ponticius, who later raised the reward to 500 crowns. Luke joined the expedition after all. At the ruins the sphinx's riddle was answered wrong; the great front gate collapsed, and the party got in through a side tunnel. Arin was badly cut in the collapse and is bleeding.
open_threads: Can Arin keep fighting with her wound?
Will Luke make it home safely?

entries.title: Sun Ruins Gate
entries.content: The ruins' only entrance is a great stone gate guarded by the sphinx.

entries.title: Guild Reward
entries.content: The guild pays 250 crowns for the Sun's Heart.

entries.title: Luke
entries.content: Max's younger brother Luke stays home with their mother while Max is away.

entries.title: Desert Weather
entries.content: Sandstorms rise in the afternoon and die down by dusk.

entries.title: Arin's Blade
entries.content: Arin carries a curved blade she took from a pirate captain.

entries.title: Bitterroot
entries.content: Bitterroot grows in the ruins' side tunnels; chewed and packed into a cut, it stops bleeding.

checkpoint.name: Reach Kepler Station
checkpoint.objective: Bring the damaged ship into Kepler Station's repair dock.

state.canon: Pell restored the reactor with a coolant bypass. The hull breach on deck three was sealed with four patches. A debris strike tore off HALO's long-range antenna, so the ship can no longer make long-range calls. Captain Okafor set a course for Kepler Station.
open_threads: Can the crew call for help without the antenna?

entries.title: Reactor Status
entries.content: The reactor is failing: coolant loop two is burned out and output is dropping.

entries.title: HALO
entries.content: HALO, the ship's AI, handles all communications, including long-range calls to any station.

entries.title: Pell
entries.content: Pell is the ship's engineer and hates being interrupted mid-repair.

entries.title: Escape Pods
entries.content: The ship carries four escape pods on deck two.

entries.title: Kepler Station
entries.content: Kepler Station is a mining outpost with a repair dock. It only answers short-range hails.

entries.title: Captain's Log
entries.content: Captain Okafor keeps a paper log in her quarters and writes in it every night.

checkpoint.name: Leave the Manor
checkpoint.objective: Pack and leave Ashworth Hall before nightfall.

state.canon: The moving portraits turned out to be a mechanism Graves works from behind the walls to scare off buyers. Lady Ashworth confessed she is selling the house to pay her late husband's debts. Max found the family records in the library.

entries.title: The Portraits
entries.content: The portraits move on their own; the whole household believes the house is haunted.

entries.title: Graves
entries.content: Graves is the elderly butler; he has served the Ashworths for forty years.

entries.title: Family Records
entries.content: The Ashworth family records were lost years ago and no one knows where they went.

entries.title: The Carriage
entries.content: The estate carriage leaves from the east gate at sunset; it is the only way back to town.

entries.title: The Library
entries.content: The library holds three hundred volumes, most of them on botany.

entries.title: The Sale
entries.content: Lady Ashworth is quietly selling Ashworth Hall to pay her late husband's debts.
